Package com.macstab.chaos.jvm.spring.boot.common

@NullMarked package com.macstab.chaos.jvm.spring.boot.common
What the Spring Boot 3 and 4 starters share: auto-configuration, startup plan and actuator endpoint.

Every type is non-null unless annotated @Nullable.

  • Class
    Description
    ChaosActuatorEndpoint
    Spring Boot Actuator endpoint for operating the chaos agent at runtime, with the operations, outcomes and HTTP statuses of the Micronaut and Quarkus endpoints (ChaosManagement).
    ChaosAutoConfiguration
    Auto-configuration that wires the chaos agent runtime into a Spring Boot application.
    ChaosAutoConfiguration.ActuatorConfiguration
    Nested configuration that exposes the Actuator endpoint when both the Actuator classes are on the classpath and macstab.chaos.actuator.enabled=true.
    ChaosHandleRegistry
    Holds the handles of plans the starter activates for the application (the startup plan), so they stop when the application context closes.
    ChaosProperties
    Configuration properties for the runtime chaos starter.
    ChaosProperties.Actuator
    Sub-properties controlling the Actuator /actuator/chaos endpoint.
    ChaosSessionFilter
    Joins the chaos session a request came from: when the request carries ChaosSession.HEADER and a session with that id is open in this JVM, the request thread is bound to it while the request is handled, so session-scoped scenarios apply to the server side of the call.
    ChaosSessionPropagationAutoConfiguration
    Registers ChaosSessionFilter for the test starters, so requests a test sends with X-Chaos-Session run in that test's chaos session.
    ChaosSessionPropagationConfiguration
    The ChaosSessionFilter bean, in servlet applications.
    OnTrustedChaosEnablementCondition
    Matches when TrustedChaosEnablement decides that chaos is enabled and the early self-attach did not fail (TrustedChaosEnablement.ATTACH_FAILED_PROPERTY): after a failed attach no chaos bean is created, so nothing attaches again.
    TrustedChaosEnablement
    Decides whether macstab.chaos.enabled=true may switch chaos on, based on which property source the value came from.
    TrustedChaosEnablement.Decision
    Outcome of evaluating the enablement flag against an environment.
